evidence: The samples were exposed to TMA and water for 1 and 0.5 s, respectively. Both precursor and water were carried in the hot-wall, viscous-flow, ALD reactor by Ar flux at 100 sccm. The Ar purge time after TMA exposure was fixed at 20 s. The duration of the Ar purge time after water exposure was set at 60 s in the standard condition.
